Identical frozen source and production build options, original core -> streaming -> KP preconditions repeated in fresh child processes for each arm. A keeps Vite build in the renderer controller; B executes the same build in a child and waits for its exit. Each arm starts a new Node controller and Chromium process, then runs small -> medium -> large, five cyclic trials/library. No CPU/timeline recording; the same 500 ms diagnostic host sampler and pre/post snapshots apply to all arms. No cache drops, added GC, delays, OS changes or competing work. methodology.fullDOM: Production React. GFM only, native code, identical neutral CSS. No virtualisation, animation, highlight or deferred rendering. Fresh page per trial, two small warmups, cyclic/reversed renderer order. Each synchronous flushSync commit includes forced layout; one rAF between chunks; separate final=true commit included. CDP TaskDuration also captures asynchronous browser work. Final semantic DOM compared to react-markdown + remark-gfm outside timing. JS heap measured after CDP GC, not total process memory.
methodology.reading: Independent cold browser context per renderer, production build. LiMR and Markstream retain default plugins/options and vendor CSS; react-markdown uses remark-gfm, remark-math, rehype-katex and an async Shiki component, neutral article CSS. LiMR default Markdown + full styles including Maple; Markstream default MarkdownRender + CSS with optional stream-diffs and KaTeX installed. Real local images; unique code/math. First readable frame is a two-rAF DOM-readiness proxy, not FCP/LCP. Compositor wheel gesture over 7 seconds, then middle/end seeks. Scroll rAF telemetry excludes snapshot scans and GC. Resource totals are measured local transfers, not npm installation or compressed bundle sizes.

conclusion.zh: 隔离构建将大文档测量前的控制进程 RSS 从约 2.4–2.5 GiB 降至约 0.56 GiB。A1 的 Markstream 出现 2355.90ms 挂载 / 1646.46ms 布局，主线程内核 CPU 在整个 run 中增加约 1.16 秒；B 未复现，但恢复相同进程内构建的 A2 也未复现。因此该实验确证构建内存残留及其消除，并未证明它必然导致旧峰值或旧峰值已被根治。正式流程采用子进程构建以减少无关资源占用，三库一视同仁；它属于测量流程调整，不计作 LiMR 实现加速。
conclusion.en: Build isolation reduced pre-large-run controller RSS from about 2.4–2.5 GiB to about 0.56 GiB. A1 recorded a Markstream mount of 2355.90ms / 1646.46ms layout, with about 1.16 seconds of main-thread kernel CPU across the complete run. B did not reproduce it, but neither did A2 after restoring in-process builds. The experiment establishes retained build memory and its removal, not that it necessarily caused historical peaks or that those peaks are fixed. The formal harness now builds in a child to reduce unrelated resource use equally for all three libraries; this is a measurement change, not a LiMR implementation speedup.
